None of us are claiming to be esports grade players, but just occasionally it'd be nice if triple A games didn't treat us like absolute babies. Whether it's aggressive amounts of tutorial, pointing out exactly where to go next or preventing us from wandering off like a lost toddler, we're tired of these AAA games hand-holding.
